exposure: Children under 3 years old born through caesarean section
cohort: Children below 10 years old in São Paulo, Brazil
finding: The study found a weak and non-statistically significant association between caesarean sections and childhood ALL overall, but a suggestive association was observed among children under 3 years old born via caesarean section.
mod_finding: This study investigated the association between cesarean sections and acute lymphoblastic leukemia in children.
